spans.s:
mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Relating to a crest or top-knot, &c.
E.
चूला for चूडा, and अण् aff.

n. (-र्म्म)
The ceremony of tonsure, cutting off all the hair from the head of a child three years old, except one lock on the crown.
E.
चौल or चौड relating to the चूडा or crest, and कर्म्मन् work, act.

m. (-क्यः)
One of the Rājarṣis or royal saints.
